scripts.lint: npm run generate && npm run validate
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -w @splicemood/alphabet && npm run build -w @splicemood/alphabet-site
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run test -w @splicemood/alphabet && python -m pytest packages/python && go test ./...
scripts.release: npm run check:generated && npm run build && npm run test
